headers.//: Long-lived assets. Listed FIRST because Firebase lets a later matching rule override an earlier one, and the app-shell rule below has to win for the files it names.

index.html, main.dart.js and the service worker ARE the app and none carry a content hash, so they must be revalidated every load. Firebase's default of max-age=3600 meant a deploy took up to an hour to reach anyone who had already visited.
